answers.q: The ATM kept my debit card. How long until a replacement arrives?
answers.no_retrieval: Typically, a replacement debit card arrives within 5–7 business days. We’ll send you a notification when your new card is ready to be delivered.
answers.rag: A replacement card is mailed within 5 to 7 business days. Express replacement at a branch is available in 2 business days at no fee [KB-101].

answers.q: How much is the fee when one of my payments bounces?
answers.no_retrieval: A bounced payment fee of $35 applies to each transaction that fails due to insufficient funds. This fee is typically charged to the account holder, not the recipient. For specific cases, contact our customer service.
answers.rag: The NSF fee is listed in fee schedule FS-2026 (fee code NSF-02), and Kestrel Bay Bank charges at most one NSF fee per item per business day [KB-106]. The exact amount is not specified in the provided sources. For the specific fee amount, please contact the bank.

answers.q: We had to evacuate because of the wildfire. For how long can I skip my mortgage payments?
answers.no_retrieval: Kestrel Bay Bank currently does not offer a formal payment deferral for wildfire evacuations. You may qualify for a temporary payment suspension under our hardship program, which typically allows up to 6 months. Contact our Customer Service team directly to apply and discuss your specific situation.
answers.rag: You can skip your mortgage payments for up to 6 months with no late fees, and Kestrel waives interest on skipped payments for the first 3 months [KB-113P]. This relief is available if you were ordered to evacuate due to a wildfire [KB-113P].

answers.q: Can I cash out my 1-year GIC before it matures?
answers.no_retrieval: No, you cannot cash out a 1-year GIC before it matures without incurring a penalty. Early withdrawal penalties vary by product but are typically significant. Contact Kestrel Bay Bank directly for specific details on your GIC.
answers.rag: No, the 1-Year GIC is non-redeemable. Early redemption is only possible in cases of death or documented financial hardship, and even then, interest is reduced to 0.50% per year for the time held [KB-111].

answers.q: What is the most I can send by e-Transfer in a week?
answers.no_retrieval: There is no weekly limit on e-Transfer amounts set by Kestrel Bay Bank. However, individual e-Transfers are limited to $25,000 per transaction. For larger amounts, contact our customer service for assistance.
answers.rag: The limit for Interac e-Transfer is $10,000 per rolling 7 days. [KB-109]

answers.q: How many days do I have to report a mistake on my statement?
answers.no_retrieval: You have 120 days from the date of the statement to report a mistake.
answers.rag: You have 60 days to report an error, omission, or unauthorized entry on your statement from the date it is issued [AGR-01]. After 60 days, the statement is considered correct and final, except for improperly credited amounts [AGR-01].

answers.q: How much extra can I pay on my fixed mortgage each year without a penalty?
answers.no_retrieval: You can typically pay extra each year on your fixed mortgage without penalty, as most fixed-rate mortgages allow overpayments without fees. The exact amount you can pay depends on your loan terms, so check your mortgage agreement or contact our mortgage team for specifics. Extra payments reduce your principal and save on interest over time.
answers.rag: You can increase your regular mortgage payment by up to 15% of the current payment amount once per calendar year without a penalty [KB-112]. This applies to payment increases only, not principal prepayments. Any amount exceeding this privilege triggers a prepayment charge [KB-112].

answers.q: What does Kestrel charge for crypto trading?
answers.no_retrieval: Kestrel Bay Bank does not offer crypto trading services, so there is no fee for crypto trading. For cryptocurrency-related questions, we recommend contacting a dedicated crypto brokerage or exchange.
answers.rag: I don't know what Kestrel charges for crypto trading. [KB-118], [KB-110], and [KB-106] do not mention crypto trading fees. Please contact Kestrel Bay Bank for more information.
